item.description: New artists and art spaces made Portland feel like its old self. by Lindsay Costello The most memorable exhibitions this year made a mess, rejecting pristine gallery walls in favor of fish skin, plastic bags, and lived-in spaces like a mall corridor and a home garage. item.title: The '99-'00 Blazers Squad Get Their Roses
item.description: Corbin Smith by Corbin Smith The 1999-2000 Portland Trail Blazers squad was an excellent basketball team.
